title: Lemon verbena drawer sachets
subtitle: Dried lemon verbena pouches for drawers and wardrobes
excerpt: Lemon verbena drawer sachets are small fabric pouches filled with dried lemon verbena leaves and orris root powder to fix the scent. The verbena gives a sharp, clean citrus-green fragrance; the orris root holds it for longer. Each sachet contains about 15 g of filling; the scent holds for four to six months before the sachet needs refreshing.
sourceNotes: Lemon verbena (Aloysia citrodora) as a drawer sachet herb: Mrs Beeton's Book of Household Management (1861). Orris root powder (Iris germanica var. florentina) as a fixative in dried herb sachets: The Pot-Pourri Book by Penny Black (1989, Simon & Schuster). Orris root is an allergen for some individuals, this is noted in the body. The lemon verbena scent is both a pleasant fragrance and a gentle moth deterrent when combined with cedar.

recipe.batchNotes: Fill as many sachets as needed from a larger batch of the blend. Store the remaining blend in an airtight jar.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Ready to use immediately once filled. The scent is strongest in the first few weeks and settles into a longer-lasting background note.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: Four to six months before the scent fades. Refresh by opening the sachet and adding a few drops of lemon verbena essential oil to the filling, or replace the filling entirely.

glossaryTerms.definition: A fine powder made from dried iris root (Iris germanica var. florentina), used as a fixative in pot-pourri and sachets. It locks volatile aromatic compounds in a blend and extends the scent life. Orris root is a known allergen in some individuals, use in ventilated areas and avoid direct skin contact with the powder.

content.text: Combine the dried lemon verbena and orris root powder in a bowl and mix well. Fill four small muslin drawstring bags or square fabric sachets (about 8 × 8 cm) with 15 g of the blend each. Tie or sew closed.

Place one sachet in a drawer, folded into a stack of clothing, or hung inside a wardrobe. The scent transfers gently to fabrics in contact with the sachet. Squeeze the sachet occasionally to release more fragrance.
When the scent fades, after four to six months, open the sachet and add five drops of lemon verbena essential oil to the filling. Or tip out the filling and replace with a fresh batch.
Four to six months of active scent. The unfilled blend keeps indefinitely in a sealed jar out of sunlight.
